title: Scheffé’s simultaneous intervals
html:
Assume @eq-opt-normal-model with r<n, and let 0<α<1.

  1. Let V⊆C(X) be a subspace of dimension q≥1. Then 𝛍𝛍maxv∈V, v≠0(v⊤Y−v⊤μ)2qs2‖v‖2=‖PV(Y−μ)‖2/qs2∼F(q,ν), and consequently 𝛍Pr(|v⊤(Y−μ)|≤qFα(q,ν)s‖v‖  ∀v∈V)=1−α.

  2. Let Λ be p×q of rank q with C(Λ)⊆C(X⊤). With probability exactly 1−α, for every 𝛌λ∈C(Λ) simultaneously, 𝛌𝛃𝛌𝛃𝛌𝛃𝛌𝛃𝛌𝛃λ⊤β∈[λ⊤β^−qFα(q,ν)se(λ⊤β^),  λ⊤β^+qFα(q,ν)se(λ⊤β^)].{#eq-mc-scheffe-interval}

    Moreover, with 𝛉𝛃θ=Λ⊤β, 𝛉𝛃θ^=Λ⊤β^ and W=Λ⊤GΛ, 𝛌𝛌𝛌𝛃𝛌𝛃𝛌𝛃𝛉𝛉𝛉𝛉maxλ∈C(Λ), λ≠0(λ⊤β^−λ⊤β)2se(λ⊤β^)2=(θ^−θ)⊤W−1(θ^−θ)s2,{#eq-mc-scheffe-max}

    attained at 𝛌𝛉𝛉λ=ΛW−1(θ^−θ).
